findings.title: 67.8% of content on / absent from raw HTML
findings.evidence: Raw HTML: 521 words. Playwright-rendered: 1616 words. Render gap: 67.8% of rendered words absent from raw crawler view. Affected URL: https://www.airbnb.com

suggested_action.summary: Implement SSR or SSG so content is in the initial HTML response. At minimum, ensure product names, prices, and key facts appear in raw HTML. Use Next.js getServerSideProps/getStaticProps or equivalent.

findings.title: 6/12 pages lack schema.org JSON-LD
findings.evidence: Only 6/12 sampled pages have JSON-LD markup. Pages without markup: /help/article/2701/extenuating-circumstances-policy-and-the-coronavirus-covid19, /help/contact-us, /help/responsible-hosting, /help/sale-share-opt-out, /help/home, /help.

suggested_action.summary: Extend JSON-LD markup to all page types. Prioritize product, article, and FAQ pages for maximum AI citation impact.

findings.title: WebSite JSON-LD missing required properties on /
findings.evidence: Page: https://www.airbnb.com. Found WebSite JSON-LD block but missing required fields: name. Present fields: url, potentialAction.

suggested_action.summary: Add the following required properties to your WebSite JSON-LD: name. See schema.org/WebSite for full spec.

findings.title: WebSite JSON-LD missing required properties on /services
findings.evidence: Page: https://www.airbnb.com/services. Found WebSite JSON-LD block but missing required fields: name. Present fields: url, potentialAction.

suggested_action.summary: Add the following required properties to your WebSite JSON-LD: name. See schema.org/WebSite for full spec.

findings.title: Physical address inconsistency — 27 variants found
findings.evidence: Found 27 distinct address strings across pages. Details: '2 BR Penthouse suite on Butler Street' on: https://www.airbnb.com/pittsburgh-pa/stays; '888 Brannan Street' on: https://www.airbnb.com/about; 'Barrett Township' on: https://www.airbnb.com/pocono-mountains-pa/stays/apartments; 'Blawnox' on: https://www.airbnb.com/pittsburgh-pa/stays. Address inconsistency is a strong negative signal for AI confidence in local business data.

suggested_action.summary: Standardize your address in a single CMS variable. Use a structured address in Organization/LocalBusiness JSON-LD with: streetAddress, addressLocality, addressRegion, postalCode, addressCountry.

findings.title: No sameAs links in any JSON-LD block
findings.evidence: Crawled 12 pages including homepage and /about. 0 pages contain a 'sameAs' property in any JSON-LD entity. Without sameAs, AI knowledge graphs cannot confidently link this site to its verified external identity on Wikidata, LinkedIn, or Crunchbase.

suggested_action.summary: Add a 'sameAs' array to your Organization JSON-LD on the homepage. Minimum recommended links: LinkedIn company page, Crunchbase profile. For highest-trust disambiguation: create a Wikidata entry and link to it. Example: "sameAs": ["https://www.linkedin.com/company/...", "https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q..."]

findings.title: Organization JSON-LD missing high-value recommended properties on /press/news
findings.evidence: Page: https://www.airbnb.com/press/news. Organization JSON-LD present and required fields satisfied, but missing recommended fields: description, legalName, sameAs. These fields significantly improve AI citation quality.

suggested_action.summary: Add recommended properties to Organization JSON-LD: description, legalName, sameAs.

findings.title: Blog/article pages detected but no Article JSON-LD found
findings.evidence: URL patterns suggest this site has blog or article pages, but no Article or BlogPosting JSON-LD was found. AI assistants rely on Article markup to properly attribute authored content.

suggested_action.summary: Add Article or BlogPosting JSON-LD to all blog posts with: headline, datePublished, dateModified, author (Person with name), image.

findings.title: Freshness signals missing on 13/15 pages
findings.evidence: Only 2/15 crawled pages have any date metadata. Pages without freshness signals are harder for AI models to date-rank.

suggested_action.summary: Systematically add dateModified to all page types, not just blog posts. Even static pages (About, Pricing) should declare a dateModified when updated.

findings.title: Organization JSON-LD missing 'legalName'
findings.evidence: Found Organization JSON-LD on 2 page(s) but none declare 'legalName'. Brand name in JSON-LD: 'Airbnb'. Without legalName, AI models cannot distinguish between organizations sharing a similar short brand name.

suggested_action.summary: Add 'legalName' to your Organization JSON-LD with your full registered company name (e.g., 'Acme Corporation Inc.' rather than just 'Acme'). This is especially important if your brand name is generic or widely shared.

findings.title: 1/80 internal links are broken (1.2%)
findings.evidence: Checked 80 unique internal link targets; 1 returned HTTP 4xx/5xx. Sample broken URLs: https://www.airbnb.com/help/responsible-hosting (HTTP 0).

suggested_action.summary: Set up 301 redirects for moved content. Delete or update links to removed pages. Add a link-checking step to your CI/CD pipeline (e.g., lychee, broken-link-checker). Configure your CMS to warn editors when linking to non-existent pages.

findings.title: About page lacks sufficient disambiguating identity facts (score: 1/6)
findings.evidence: About page: https://www.airbnb.com/about. Detected disambiguating facts: industry vertical. Missing categories: founding year, location hq, team size, customer count, geographic reach. Generic About pages increase the risk of AI entity confusion.

suggested_action.summary: Improve the About page to include specific facts: founding year, HQ city/country, industry vertical, team size, customer count, and geographic reach. These specifics help AI models build an accurate entity profile.
